title: Bob the Pug
text: He lives with the Smith family in a flat in London.
Bob loves food, but he doesn't like walks.
Every morning Mrs Smith takes him to the park.
There Bob sits down and doesn't want to go.
Yesterday a girl dropped her sandwich near a bench.
Bob ran to it so fast that Mrs Smith dropped her bag.
Now Bob loves walks, but only to that bench.
